prompt: A regular hexagon has $6$ equal sides each $4$ cm. Find its perimeter.
hint: Perimeter is the total length of all the sides. In a regular hexagon every side has the same length.

hints.text: Perimeter is the total length of all the sides. In a regular hexagon every side has the same length.
There are $6$ sides and each one is $4$ cm long. Instead of adding $4$ six times, multiply $6 \times 4$.
$6 \times 4 = 24$, so the perimeter of the hexagon is $24$ centimeters.

explanation: The perimeter of any polygon is the sum of its side lengths.
A regular hexagon has $6$ equal sides, so the sum is $4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4$, or $6 \times 4$.
Six groups of four make twenty-four, so $6 \times 4 = 24$.
The perimeter of the hexagon is $24$ centimeters.
